explanation: 
Per the official Microsoft Learn doc ["Create and publish workbooks for Microsoft Sentinel solutions"](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/sentinel/sentinel-workbook-creation), templateRelativePath is documented as a bare filename relative to the solution's own Workbooks/ folder (see the sample: "templateRelativePath": "MyNewWorkbook.json"), not a full repo path.

The [UniFi](https://www.ui.com/) Syslog solution for Microsoft Sentinel ingests UDM, switch and access-point syslog telemetry using the Codeless Connector Framework (CCF) Push pattern. A self-hosted Logstash relay parses the UniFi dual-timestamp format, normalises CEF and synthetic-CEF events, enriches with MaxMind GeoIP/ASN and FireHOL/Spamhaus/Tor threat-intel feeds at ingest time, and POSTs to the Data Collection Endpoint provisioned by this connector. **Pipeline split:** - CEF + synthetic-CEF security events land in **CommonSecurityLog** (firewall zones, sudo, dnsmasq-dhcp, AP kernel WiFi, ubios gateway signals, switch link state, sshd). - Forensic / non-CEF events land in **Unifi_Syslog_CL** as a structured catch-all. **Ships:** 8 analytic rules (TI match, IDS/IPS, SSH brute force, firewall drops, admin-from-WAN, VPN brute force, Tor traffic, critical-severity) and 10 hunting queries (top attackers, port scanners, app-port probes, first-seen sources, geo anomaly, sudo audit, SSH targets, WiFi deauth flood, DHCP anomalies, TI feed effectiveness). **Pre-requisites:** 1. A Linux host reachable from your UniFi devices on UDP/TCP 514 (UnRAID, Docker host, k8s, VM). 2. The Logstash container shipped with this Solution under its `Logstash/` subfolder (Dockerfile + logstash.conf + MaxMind/TI refreshers). 3. (Optional but recommended) A MaxMind account for GeoIP/ASN enrichment - free GeoLite2 tier is sufficient. **Data Connectors:** 1, **Workbooks:** 1, **Analytic Rules:** 8, **Hunting Queries:** 10 [Learn more about Microsoft Sentinel](https://aka.ms/azuresentinel) | [Learn more about Solutions](https://aka.ms/azuresentinelsolutionsdoc)",

The logo is committed to both locations, so the URL is valid:

- Repo-root `Logos/UnifiSyslog.svg` — this is what `createUiDefinition.json` references via `.../master/Logos/UnifiSyslog.svg`. The URL will resolve once the PR merges to master.
- `Workbooks/Images/Logos/UnifiSyslog.svg` — a second copy per the workbook-images convention Microsoft reviewer required on PR #14253.

The PR description mentioned `Workbooks/Images/Logos/` because that was the newly-added file; `Logos/UnifiSyslog.svg` at repo root was added as part of the initial solution commit. Both files present, URL correct.

Brief pre-merge false positive here since master doesn't have the file yet — same hyperlink-validator false positive every new-solution PR hits.

Editing it would be reverted on the next package regeneration and diverge from other solutions, so leaving as-is.
